en.caption:
A moment of appreciation, every few days.

A card turns up in your Q&A list on its own.
It rotates through five kinds: gratitude, compliment, affirmation, cheer, and promise.
Sent exactly as you wrote it — Dear doesn't tidy it up.
They answer with a heart, and a line if they feel like it.

#couples #couplegoals #appreciation #relationshipgoals #couplesapp #dailyquestions #DearApp
en.threads: The card goes out exactly as you wrote it. No tidying step, on purpose — a polished thank-you reads like a greeting card.
